AI Job Agent

Turning a scattered search into a structured view.

PROJECT CONTEXTPersonal learning project
PROFILE DATEMay 2026
TOOLS & APPROACHPython · Pandas · Natural-language queries

The question

Job discovery often means repeating the same search across different platforms, then trying to compare inconsistent results. This project explores how aggregation, standardization, and filtering can make that information easier to use.

From many sources to one view

CollectVacancies from multiple platforms
StandardizeValidate fields and handle duplicates
DiscoverQuery, filter, and compare opportunities

Validation and deduplication sketch

NaukriRemoteOKWellfound
Collect. Clean. Connect.

My LinkedIn project entry describes multi-platform aggregation, natural-language search for role and location, automated validation and deduplication, salary analysis, an analytics dashboard, REST APIs, and notification workflows.

The business analysis lens

The quality of the result depends on defining what a useful opportunity actually means. Different sources may describe the same role in different ways, and missing information should remain visible instead of being guessed.

  • Requirements: separate essential filters from preferences.
  • Data quality: define when two listings represent the same opportunity.
  • Usability: keep source information and missing salary data understandable.
  • Validation: compare results against explicit search criteria.

A continuing exploration

My later Hiring Radar and Career Intelligence Agent posts continue exploring this problem, including automated collection and SQLite storage. They reflect an ongoing interest in making job discovery more structured and useful.
